description: [PAID $5.00 USDC per call via x402] Step 2: with the signature from agent_register_prepare, LogicNodes hosts the registration file at https://logicnodes.io/a/<address>/registration.json and the agent card next to it, and returns the unsigned transaction that calls register(tokenURI) on the ERC-8004 identity registry on Base (0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432). Your agent signs and sends it and pays the gas; LogicNodes never holds keys. Calling again with a new signature updates the hosted files.

a2aUrl.description: the agent's own A2A JSON-RPC endpoint

address.description: the agent's EVM address (it signs the publish message and the registration transaction)

x402.description: true if the agent accepts x402 payments

name: agent_register_publish
title: Host the agent's files and build its ERC-8004 registration transaction
